category_title: Sociable adolescent with Rett Syndrome and complex medical needs
minimal_context: Evie is participating in an hour-long art session with developmentally appropriate activities.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for our hour-long art session. Here are the materials for the activity.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Evie uses eye gaze to look at the materials, then makes a reaching motion toward the adult while making a differentiated vocalization.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What do you think we should do next?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Evie shakes her head, pushes the art materials away, and makes a sharp, small noise.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to keep going with the art activity. Here is a piece of banana.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Evie becomes completely disengaged from the activity, turning her head away and escalating to crying, showing she is unhappy and having difficulty expressing herself.)

task.content: Participating in an hour-long Art session

context.materials: developmentally appropriate activities, pieces of a banana

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: through a lack of available support and/or through her own difficulties expressing herself
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: She became disengaged at several points during the activities

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: made 56 bids for communication (almost 1 per minute)... including eye gaze, facial expression, simple motor actions, crying, reaching, pushing away, showing, headshakes, nods and differentiated vocalizations
